zh.title: 卡達航空Qsuite榮獲2026年旅客選擇獎最佳商務艙
zh.summary: 卡達航空於2026年旅客選擇獎獲選最佳商務艙；該評選完全由旅客投票決定。
body: 在2026年AirlineRatings.com的旅客選擇獎（Flyers' Choice Awards）中，卡達航空（Qatar Airways）的Qsuite產品獲選為最佳首選商務艙。這項評選結果完全根據廣大旅客的投票決定，卡達航空在評比中擊敗了阿聯酋航空與新加坡航空等競爭對手。
卡達航空最早於2017年3月在柏林國際旅遊展（ITB Berlin）首次公開Qsuite產品。儘管近年來多家航空公司相繼推出配備隱私門與平躺座椅的新型商務艙，卡達航空仍持續以Qsuite為基礎，並著手推出新一代Qsuite Next Gen產品。此外，國泰航空（Cathay Pacific）的Aria Suite則在東北亞地區的競爭者中排名第一。

en.title: Qatar Airways Qsuite Voted World Best Business Class in 2026 Passenger Awards
en.summary: Qatar Airways won top business class in the 2026 AirlineRatings.com Flyers Choice Awards based on passenger votes.
body: Qatar Airways took first place for Preferred Business Class in the 2026 AirlineRatings.com Flyers' Choice Awards. Unlike editorial recognitions, the awards were determined entirely by votes from airline passengers. Qatar Airways secured the top spot ahead of Emirates in second place and Singapore Airlines in third place.

Qatar Airways originally unveiled the Qsuite seating concept at ITB Berlin in March 2017. As competing airlines have introduced updated premium products, Qatar Airways is now developing its cabin experience with the upcoming Qsuite Next Gen. Meanwhile, Cathay Pacific's Aria Suite ranked first among regional competitors in North East Asia in the same passenger vote.
